title.instructions: Use <Program> <Role> — <bounded task>. Keep it under 60 characters and name the role explicitly when the workspace contains orchestrated agents.

branchName.instructions: Use Conventional Branch format: <type>/<scope>-<short-desc>. Use lowercase kebab-case and no agent or model names.

commitMessage.instructions: Follow Conventional Commits: <type>(<scope>): <imperative summary>. Describe one coherent change and do not mention the agent or model.

pullRequest.instructions: Use a concise Conventional Commit-style title. In the body include Summary, Verification, and Risk sections, and list any intentionally skipped checks.
